note: Factions as stubs (S3.4; brief §11, D-012). Ids are stable; names are provisional working names until S7.4 gives each a look, values, what it buys and bans, and a voice. S3.4 needs them only as clients of contracts and as the people who run the checkpoints, so each has an id, a name and a line. S3.5 fills these out.

items.name: The Receivers
items.line: What is left of the company's administrators, reclaiming assets one patrol line at a time.

items.name: The Outer Stations Union
items.line: The miners' union that keeps the outer stations breathing, and keeps a list.

items.name: The Quiet Order
items.line: A religious order that thinks the emptiness of the Reach is holy and should stay that way.

items.name: The Free Confederation
items.line: Pirate crews with a written code. The code is long, and mostly about shares.

items.name: Reach Medical Cooperative
items.line: A medical and research collective that pays well and asks very few questions.
